title: PDF availability as a quiet file icon everywhere; short citations in the Library
acceptance_criteria: Given the Library, the sidebar Papers list, the @ picker and the command palette, when a paper renders, then its leading icon shows PDF state (attached, none, preparing or failed) as specified, with a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus and equivalent screen-reader text. No 'Ready to read', 'PDF needed', 'Preparing PDF' or 'Processing failed' text badge remains.

Given a Library row, when it renders, then its byline is the shared PaperCitation, 'Surname et al. (Year), *Venue*', with the venue truncating first; the full author list is available in the paper details sheet (ARA-097).
Given the paper workspace header, when the PDF is ready, then no status label or icon appears; when it is not ready, only the state icon with its tooltip appears beside the title.
Given the @ picker, when a paper has no ready PDF, then its row shows the state icon instead of a badge, stays unselectable, and its tooltip says why it can't be asked about yet.

Given DocumentStatusBadge, PaperStatusBadge and documentStateLabels, when this lands, then they are deleted or replaced by one shared PdfStateIcon (single implementation), and DESIGN.md documents the icon and drops status-badge colour for PDF state.
Given light, dark and 390px, when these surfaces render, then icons meet the contrast floor (3:1 for graphics) and nothing overflows.
test_cases: Component: PdfStateIcon for each state (icon, tooltip text, screen-reader text, reduced-motion spinner).
Library, sidebar, picker, palette and header render the icon and no badge text.
Visual check in light, dark and at 390px, run by the lead.
verification: Phase 1 on 2026-10-10 (Library, sidebar, palette, DESIGN.md). Red: PdfStateIcon.test.tsx failed on the missing module; library and shell tests failed with 'Unable to find role="img" and name "No PDF yet"' and 'Unable to find an element with the text: Vaswani et al. (2017)'. Green: 646 vitest tests passed in one full run, then focused runs passed; two full runs under load showed unrelated timeouts in other files that passed when rerun alone. Visual round with Chromium at 1100px and 390px, light and dark: no horizontal overflow, tooltip opens on hover. Phase 2 (picker, workspace header, deletion of DocumentStatusBadge/PaperStatusBadge/document-state, e2e text) pending ARA-096 and ARA-097.
